_comment: Message templates for the clients, per localization (S11: all fourteen localizations and the sixteen kinds of docs/07-LOCALIZATION.md section 6). Placeholders: {name} {service} {professional} {date} {time} {deadline} {minutes} {link}; every kind uses the same placeholders in every localization (scripts/check-strings.sh checks it, and firebase/functions/test/unit/messaging.test.ts checks confirmation and reminder against the WhatsApp templates). {date} = weekday + day + month without year, formatted by the locale; {time} per the locale clock; {deadline} = date and time of the free-change limit. Link base comes from BELLO_WEB_BASE_URL. The first four kinds are the prototype's wording; the professional's own editable quick replies live in the app catalog (quickReplies.default.*). es-419 is es-MX with a few neutral words and en-GB is en: both are written out here because this file is read as is. Client messages use the polite address (de Sie, id Anda, tr siz) and never contain clinical content (docs/06 section 8).
